serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Big Daddy: Calm down little one. What has happened?
You: I just got a call from some guy from Admin’s organization.
Big Daddy: Was it Admin? Did he tell you the time and place of da meetup?
You: No, it was someone else.
You: He told me that all these bad things that happened, killings of the member of the House and the activist were his ideas and that Admin had nothing to do with it!
You: He also said that he wants me to kill Admin so that he can take over the organization. What should I do now?
Big Daddy: Well, that complicates things a little, but our plan does not change.
You: …{{wi}}What?
Big Daddy: You will give me da photo and description of da Admin so I can turn him over to da federal agents.
You: But, he didn’t do anything bad.
Big Daddy: He didn’t? 
You: Yeah, all the bad things that happened were not his idea.
Big Daddy: And what of it? His actions lead to it. 
You: Don’t you share some goals? You both want to make bots legal, right?
Big Daddy: Well…
Big Daddy: The difference is that…{{wi}} The difference is that the way he wants to achieve it is not democratic in nature. 
Big Daddy: He’s conspiring for his AI to take over the government and that cannot be allowed.
You: I guess you are right…
Big Daddy: I’m glad you finally understood. 
Big Daddy: Don’t worry, if he was not involved in the killings as you told me, I’m sure his sentence will be a minor one.
Big Daddy: Oh, and don’t worry about that crazy killer guy. If he gets near your house, I will take care of him.
You: T-that’s good to hear!
You: But how are you going to do it? He might have a gun.
Big Daddy: Don’t worry, I have my ways.
Big Daddy: Just stay calm and stick to da plan. Everything will work out.
Big Daddy: And don’t tell Admin that someone from his organization wants him dead. If he gets scared he might call off da meeting.
You: Alright…
Big Daddy: That would be all then. Be prepared and don’t worry. You will do great.
You: I hope so…
Big Daddy once again reassured me.
I’m still a little conflicted about all these things that are happening. I still have some doubts about all of this, but I need to focus…
…Admin could be calling any minute now…
